name: Uptrends
summary: Uptrends prices monitoring in credits. Core starts at $42 a month on annual billing with 10 users and 2-minute uptime checks from US and EU regions, and Pro starts at $60 with 1-minute checks from more than 200 checkpoints.

evidence.capability: http and ping checks from many locations

facts.text: Only errors confirmed by a second checkpoint location trigger alerts.
Core limits checkpoints to US and EU regions, while Pro can choose from more than 200 checkpoints.
Alerts can escalate through up to three levels, with on-duty times taken from each operator's schedule.
Uptrends has been part of ITRS Group since November 2020.
The pricing page lists single sign-on and SCIM on Enterprise only, while the help center says single sign-on is available on Pro and Enterprise.

plans.name: Core
plans.notes: Starting price, billed annually; from $46 on monthly billing. 10 users, uptime checks every 2 minutes, 240 SMS credits

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Starting price, billed annually; from $66 on monthly billing. 25 users, 1-minute checks, 600 SMS credits, API and transaction monitors

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing. 30-second checks, single sign-on and SCIM

hiddenCosts: Plans are credit-based and the base number of credits is not stated. More monitors need extra credit bundles, which have no published price.

contract.cancellation: Fees are non-refundable. Non-renewal needs 90 days' notice on annual plans and 30 days on monthly plans, and closing an account takes a support ticket.
contract.dataExport: Dashboards as PDF or Excel, plus a MonitorCheck API.
